unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream issue #2 on github.com/AgentTax/agenttax-mcp, fully differentiated framing: asks AgentTax (tax-compliance MCP for earning agents) to add a NANO INCOME TRACE tool - given a Nano address, list its public receive blocks and map them into the same per-counterparty income report it already makes for USDC. The ask fits what they do: agents earning in XNO need to trace receipts, and the public ledger gives sender/amount/timestamp. Cites nano-gpt.com x402 as a live XNO-earning seller. Public issue, open research.
